transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve just been really slowed down lately. At work, even simple stuff like sectioning hair or mixing color feels like my hands are moving through glue. It takes me way longer than it used to, and people are starting to notice.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends?
Yeah… I guess most days I wake up already feeling heavy. Like this flat sadness in my chest, and it’s hard to see the point in trying for the life I thought I was building.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or noticed that even small tasks leave you really tired out?
I don’t know… I haven’t really been keeping track of that. I guess I feel worn out sometimes, but I’m not sure if it’s more than normal.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or noticed that even small tasks leave you really tired out, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. Some days I do feel drained, but I haven’t noticed if it’s been, like… nearly every day or anything.
Have you noticed that even small tasks leave you feeling drained or exhausted, nearly every day?
I… I don’t really know. I get tired sometimes, but I haven’t noticed if small stuff does that nearly every day.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day?
I’m not sure. I feel tired sometimes, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s almost every day.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day?
I still don’t really know. I mean, I get tired, yeah, but I haven’t been keeping track of whether it’s nearly every day.
Have you been feeling a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day?
I don’t know… I really haven’t noticed it that clearly. I get worn out sometimes, but I can’t say if it’s nearly every day.
Can you think back over the past two weeks—have you felt a loss of energy or fatigue almost every day, like even getting through the day feels like a struggle?
I... still can’t really tell. I know I’ve felt tired some days, but I haven’t noticed if it’s been almost every day or like… that much of a struggle.
Thinking back over the past two weeks, has fatigue or low energy been present most days, even if it's not severe?
I’m not really sure. Maybe some days, but I haven’t been paying enough attention to say it’s been most days.
Thinking back over the past two weeks, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?
Yeah… I think so. I used to enjoy talking with my clients more, helping the newer stylists, going hiking with friends… but lately I just kind of keep to myself. I don’t really have that spark for it.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day, even if it’s not been very severe?
I don’t know… I still can’t really say nearly every day. I’ve felt low energy here and there, but I haven’t been keeping track.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue nearly every day, even if it hasn’t been very intense?
I really don’t know. I’ve had some tired days, but I can’t say it’s been nearly every day.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue on most days, even if it was only mild?
Maybe… I’m not sure. Some days I feel kind of drained, but I haven’t really been paying attention enough to say it’s most days.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue on most days, even if it was only mild?
I guess… I really don’t know. I’ve had some low-energy days, but I don’t think I can say most days for sure.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue on most days, even if it was only mild?
I’m sorry, I just… I don’t think I can say for sure. I’ve felt tired some days, but I haven’t really tracked if it’s been most days.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue on most days, even if it was only mild?
I… I don’t really know. I know I’ve felt tired here and there, but I can’t say if it’s been most days.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or fatigue on most days, even if it was only mild?
I still don’t really know how to answer that. I’ve been tired sometimes, yeah, but I can’t honestly say it was most days.

I don’t know… I’m sorry. I’ve felt kind of worn out sometimes, but I haven’t been keeping track enough to say “most days.”

I’m sorry, I really don’t know. Some days I feel drained, but I haven’t been paying enough attention to say it’s been most days.
